edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as _from into transferFrom via transfer()/allowance checks.
owner is assigned from msg.sender in the constructor, making caller-controlled input the privilege root.
Constructor reads msg.sender to set owner and initial balance.
approve() writes allowance keyed by msg.sender.
init() authenticates with require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress() authenticates with require(msg.sender == owner).
_from is passed into the ensure() whitelist gate.
_to is compared against owner/UNI whitelist inside ensure().
transferFrom() requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating state.
ensure() calls condition() to validate the sale when the sender is not whitelisted.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition() reads the configured _saleNum limit.
condition() compares _minSale against _value.
condition() compares _maxSale against _value.
ensure() consults the canSale whitelist mapping for _from.
ensure() compares _from against the tradeAddress whitelist.
ensure() compares _from/_to against the owner address.
ensure() compares _from against the constant UNI router address.
ensure() derives the pair address via pairFor() and compares it with _from.
Local _UNI pair address computed by pairFor() is used in the whitelist check.
balanceOf[_from] is read and then decremented in transferFrom.
balanceOf[_to] is credited in transferFrom.
transferFrom reads balanceOf for the sender and recipient.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from].
_value flows into the unchecked allowance subtraction.
_from and msg.sender index the allowance mapping that is decremented without a safety check.
transferFrom performs allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value without SafeMath.
_value flows into the unchecked balance subtraction/addition.
_from indexes balanceOf for the unchecked subtraction.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf with unchecked subtraction and addition.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
_value is a multiplicand in the unchecked batchSend total computation.
_tos.length is a multiplicand in the unchecked batchSend total computation.
delegate() performs an external delegatecall to a caller-supplied address, allowing full storage takeover.
Parameter a is the target of the arbitrary delegatecall.
Parameter b is the calldata executed via delegatecall.
setTradeAddress writes the privileged tradeAddress whitelist entry.
addr parameter is stored into tradeAddress.
init() writes the sale count limit used by condition().
init() writes _minSale used by condition().
init() writes _maxSale used by condition().
saleNum parameter is assigned to _saleNum.
token parameter is scaled by decimals to become _minSale.
maxToken parameter is scaled by decimals to become _maxSale.
decimals is used to scale the min/max sale values in init().
_spender parameter keys the allowance mapping written by approve().
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
transfer() forwards execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as source.
_to parameter flows into transfer().
_value parameter flows into transfer().
Constructor sets totalSupply from the supplied supply.
The initial balance/allowance grant is keyed by msg.sender in the constructor.
batchSend debits the owner and credits each recipient in balanceOf.
_tos array is iterated to credit recipients in batchSend.
_value is credited to each recipient in batchSend.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only used as an argument of transfer(), so it collapses into that core function node.
_value is only used as an argument of transfer(), so it collapses into that core function node.
_from is the transferFrom source and authorization key, so it collapses into transferFrom.
_to of transferFrom is the credit target, so it collapses into transferFrom.
_value directly feeds the unchecked allowance subtraction unsafe operation.
_spender is the only key written by approve(), so it collapses into approve.
a is the direct target of the arbitrary delegatecall unsafe operation.
b is the direct calldata of the arbitrary delegatecall unsafe operation.
saleNum is assigned to _saleNum inside init(), so it collapses into init.
token is scaled into _minSale inside init(), so it collapses into init.
maxToken is scaled into _maxSale inside init(), so it collapses into init.
_tos.length is a multiplicand of the unchecked multiplication unsafe operation.
_value is a multiplicand of the unchecked multiplication unsafe operation.
addr is directly stored into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress().
_UNI is a temporary only consumed by the ensure() whitelist check.
total is the direct result of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
